# Active work — lege-docwrite

Live work, grouped by parent in `ROADMAP.md` order. Blocked work names its blocker inline.

## [M7 — images, bidi, IDML spreads, CFF and PDF links](ROADMAP.md#m7--images-bidi-idml-spreads-cff-and-pdf-links) `@docwrite.milestone.m7-open-items/1`

### Right-to-left and mixed-direction text

`proposed` · `@docwrite.work.m7-bidi/1` · part of `@docwrite.milestone.m7-open-items/1`

unicode-bidi is a dependency but paragraphs are shaped left to right; resolve embedding levels, shape runs in their direction and reorder lines for display, caret and PDF.

### EPUB export, if it proves useful

`proposed` · `@docwrite.work.m7-epub/1` · part of `@docwrite.milestone.m7-open-items/1`

Markdown and PDF cover the semantic and print paths; an EPUB 3 package from the same blocks and styles is optional.

### IDML with spreads and threaded text frames

`proposed` · `@docwrite.work.m7-idml-spreads/1` · part of `@docwrite.milestone.m7-open-items/1`

export_idml writes a design map, styles, one master spread and the story, but no spreads or text frames, so InDesign has nowhere to flow the story; emit spreads per page pair with threaded frames on the master's text area. Not yet opened in InDesign.

### Place images in the page flow

`proposed` · `@docwrite.work.m7-images/1` · part of `@docwrite.milestone.m7-open-items/1`

Image blocks lay out as text today; read the asset's size, place it full-measure or inline with its caption kept with it, draw it on screen and embed it in the PDF (JPEG/PNG through lege-pdf-write).

### PDF link annotations and named destinations

`proposed` · `@docwrite.work.m7-pdf-links/1` · part of `@docwrite.milestone.m7-open-items/1`

Links and citations are plain text in the PDF; add link annotations (URIs, and internal destinations for contents, index and citations) to lege-pdf-write and use them.

## Unparented

### lege-pdf-write: subset and embed TrueType and CFF fonts

`proposed` · `@lege.work.font-subsetting-and-cff/1`

Subset fonts to the glyphs used (e.g. the subsetter crate) and embed both FontFile2 TrueType and FontFile3 CFF/OpenType programs with correct widths and descriptors.

### lege-pdf-write: links, named destinations and page labels

`proposed` · `@lege.work.links-labels-destinations/1`

Add link annotations (internal and URI), named destinations for chapters/notes, page labels (roman front matter, arabic body), and streaming finalize without a fixed page count.

### lege-pdf-write: path operators, RGB fill and Flate images

`proposed` · `@lege.work.vector-paths-and-color/1`

Add path construction/stroke/fill operators and RGB colour for rules, underlines and ornaments, and Flate-compressed RGB/alpha images with SMask.

### Optional damage rectangles through the presenter

`proposed` · `@pixelkit.work.damage-rects/1`

Let render report damaged rectangles and let presenters use them (softbuffer present_with_damage), keeping full-frame repaint as the default.
